info.title: Little Baby Bum: Che musica!
info.synopsis: Vieni a divertirti in questa magica scuola materna dove ogni giorno è un'avventura piena di canzoni per bambini e tante cose da imparare!

cast.name: Siu-see Hung
cast.role: Mia & Max's Mom / Mapple's Mom Beth (voice)

cast.name: Harriet Kershaw
cast.role: Bari's Gran / Maple's Mom Rose / Kimberly Wimberly (voice)

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: After learning about musical rests and how loud and soft sounds make us feel, the class pretends to be cats — singing together as a kitten choir!

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: The kids welcome a new student to class, practice a song about brushing their teeth, and learn all about the magic of melodies.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Timberly uses a keyboard to teach the kids about tempo and brings a special guest to class to play the bagpipes. Bari learns to look on the bright side.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: A familiar tune helps Twinkle get her glow back. Later, the kids learn about a Chinese string instrument called an erhu and celebrate different holidays.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: The friends have fun with high and low notes, play a silly game of jack-in-the-box, and learn how to warm up their voices on a cold, snowy day.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Music helps Max learn to count, Maple brings her trumpet to school, and the class makes lots of different sounds — all without instruments!

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Timberly helps Bari feel the beat, then the kids help her find a special instrument: a West African shekere! Ahan's uncle plays the dhol, a Punjabi drum.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: La bacchetta del direttore d'orchestra attira l'attenzione di tutti, la classe canta una canzone sulla buonanotte durante la Giornata dell'Orso Teddy e i bambini creano musica con oggetti di tutti i giorni.

translations.value: La bacchetta del direttore d'orchestra attira l'attenzione di tutti, la classe canta una canzone sulla buonanotte durante la Giornata dell'Orso Teddy e i bambini creano musica con oggetti di tutti i giorni.

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: This kid-friendly playlist of Music Time songs includes 40 minutes of continuous music, from "Wheels on the Bus" to "Pat-a-Cake."

seasons.name: Stagione 2
seasons.plot: Class is back in session at the magical Music Time preschool, where friends Mia, Max, Maple, Ahan and Bari are learning more than ever before!

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Timberly dresses like a farmer to teach the class about barnyard animals. Later, the kids tidy up the classroom and learn greetings in other languages.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: The kids learn the magic of singing songs in a round, then solve a silly mystery: Where's Tootson? Max leads a march in star-shaped sunglasses.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: On Halloween, the kids wear their costumes to school. Pop, pop... hop! Ahan brings bubbles to class! Timberly helps her students write a song.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Un vero DJ visita la classe per creare musica per il compleanno di Maple. Max e Mia ricevono un nuovo cucciolo. I bambini trascorrono la giornata imparando tutto sulla batteria.

translations.value: Un vero DJ visita la classe per creare musica per il compleanno di Maple. Max e Mia ricevono un nuovo cucciolo. I bambini trascorrono la giornata imparando tutto sulla batteria.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: The kids learn about instrument families, then get to choose a song for the Rainbow Stage! Bari wants to share his Gran's song with the class.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Ahan's pet fish inspires a lesson about singing and breathing. Timberly teaches the class about the piano, then the kids make music with everyday items.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: The kids celebrate Valentine's Day, then learn that tap shoes make really fun sounds. Timberly and her cousin Kimberly teach the class about harmony.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: The kids change the lyrics to a familiar song to make it happier. Timberly gives the class tambourines, then teaches them how to make practice more fun!

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: Enjoy 40 minutes of continuous music with this kid-friendly playlist of songs from the show, including "Baby Shark" and "Row, Row, Row Your Boat."

Come join the fun at the magical Music Time preschool, where every day is an adventure filled with kid-friendly songs — and lots of learning!
